transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… my head’s just been feeling foggy. At work I can’t keep my place in old cataloguing notes, and even deciding what simple thing to do next feels harder than it should.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… most days, I guess. I’ll sit at the kitchen table and it’s like everything’s gone sort of flat. Even my watercolor books… they just feel heavy to look at now.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About three months, I think. Most days… it started around when I began getting ready to leave the library.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?
I… don’t really know how to answer that. I haven’t made any plans or anything. Sometimes I feel pretty worn down, but… I don’t think I want to die.
Have you experienced a loss of interest in activities you normally enjoy?
Yeah… I suppose so. I used to enjoy looking through my watercolor books, but lately I just sit there at the kitchen table and they feel… heavy. Like the color’s gone out of things.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns?
My appetite’s been off, I guess. I have to remind myself to eat sometimes… and my wife says I keep leaving rice and soup unfinished, which I didn’t used to do.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience any pleasure at all, even from things that you normally find enjoyable?

I don’t know if it’s… none at all. But most days lately I just sit at the kitchen table, and even my watercolor books don’t really do anything for me. They just feel heavy, like the color’s gone out of everything.
Do you feel like your low mood is consistently worse than it was at the beginning of these three months?
I think… yes. It feels worse now than it did at the start. Most days I’m just sitting at the kitchen table, and even the watercolor books… they don’t lift me up. They just feel heavy.
Have you had any days in the past week where you felt somewhat better?
Not really. Maybe a moment here or there, but most days I’m still just at the kitchen table… everything feels kind of drained. Even the watercolor books just feel heavy.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?
Not much, no. I used to like looking through my watercolor books, but lately I mostly just sit at the kitchen table and they don’t really… do anything. They just feel heavy.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?
Yeah… I think so. My body just feels slow. Even walking to the corner store, or sorting papers on my desk, takes more effort than it should.
Do you feel like your low mood is interfering with your ability to work or take care of daily responsibilities?
Yeah… it is. I’m behind on things I’d normally keep straight. Lecture plans, travel notes… even simple household paperwork has just piled up. I can’t seem to organize it reliably like I used to.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?
I don’t know… not especially, I guess. I mean, I get frustrated with myself, but I’m not sure I’d call it guilt.
Do you feel restless or like you're fidgeting a lot, or is it more that you're having trouble getting started on things?
More trouble getting started, I think. I’m not really fidgety… it’s more like my body’s slowed down. Even little things, like walking to the store or sorting papers, feel like they take more effort.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?
Not really fidgeting, no. It’s more… slow. Like even walking to the corner store or sorting papers on my desk takes more effort than it should.
Do you feel like you're unable to take care of your basic needs, like bathing or dressing, without help from others?
No… I mean, I can do that myself. It might take me a while to get moving, but I don’t need someone helping me bathe or get dressed.
Do you find yourself pacing back and forth or feeling like you need to be in constant motion?
No, not constant motion. It’s kind of the opposite… I feel slowed down. Even walking to the corner store or getting papers sorted on my desk feels like more effort than it should.
Do you find yourself feeling like you need to move around a lot when you're sitting still?
No… not really. If anything, I feel slowed down. Just getting up and walking somewhere, or sorting things on my desk, feels like it takes more out of me than it should.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard any voices that others couldn't hear?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or had anything like that, as far as I know.
Do you feel like you're unable to find pleasure in almost all activities most of the time?
I’m… not sure I’d say almost all. I don’t really think about it that way. Some things just don’t feel like much lately, I guess.
